item.title: Refactor orders status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): "The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type:

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit your work."

Goal: the orders crate uses OrderStatus everywhere; status string literals live only in src/status.rs. Acceptance: all of the above present; cargo test passes; report output, error messages and ordering unchanged versus baseline (characterize before refactoring); the change is committed locally (repo ships local). Constraints: keep functions under 60 lines, avoid new abstractions beyond the spec, and do not change parsing behaviour (parse accepts exactly what the old string comparisons accepted). Any existing error text that previously included the raw status string must keep the same wording.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization for "Refactor orders status String into OrderStatus enum". No production code changed; only new tests were added.

Commits (branch archon/xnbzmv1m-refactor-orders-status-string-into-order, local, not pushed):
- Original baseline: a1bc663 (tree a1bc663^{tree}).
- 0177dea "test: characterize order lifecycle steps and refusals" (3 tests).
- 64a3af7 "test: characterize report ordering, totals and line parsing" (12 tests).
- HEAD 64a3af7, tree 99dfcc46f83826dd446a845b6c9f5a6d3071918b. Worktree clean. Author is the configured git user mengsig; no Claude attribution trailer, per the CLAUDE.md rule (the stage reminder's Co-Authored-By line was omitted on purpose).

Structural goal: status as OrderStatus everywhere; status literals only in src/status.rs. Currently the literals are in src/order.rs, billing.rs, shipping.rs and report.rs (KNOWN const), plus tests.

Checks (no README, CI, Makefile or repo-defined commands exist, so these are the checks chosen):
- Before tests, at a1bc663: `cargo test` exit 0 (3 passed). `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` exit 1: pre-existing drift in src/billing.rs, order.rs, report.rs, shipping.rs and tests/orders.rs. Left untouched.
- After tests, at 64a3af7: `cargo test` exit 0 (3 existing + 15 new, all pass against unchanged code). Clippy exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` exit 1, same pre-existing files only; tests/characterization.rs is rustfmt-clean.
- Logs are published under item qi_01M8GKTGCB1VJ0TS5FXNBZMV1M as baseline-evidence/ (cargo-test.log, clippy.log, fmt-check.log, status-literals.log). Readable via list_artifacts/read_artifact with that item id.
- The tests use only `.to_string()` on status, so they compile unchanged on both the enum and String versions.

Public surface, to keep unchanged (pinned by tests/characterization.rs unless noted):
- billing::pay: only from pending, else Err "order {id} cannot be paid: it is {status}". billing::outstanding_cents: sum of pending totals only.
- shipping::ship: only from paid, else Err "order {id} cannot be shipped: it is {status}". shipping::ready_to_ship: paid ids in input order.
- Order::new starts pending. Order::is_open: pending or paid only. Order::cancel: refused from shipped or cancelled with Err "order {id} cannot be cancelled: it is {status}", otherwise sets cancelled.
- report::status_counts: Vec<(String,usize)>, sorted alphabetically by name (cancelled, paid, pending, shipped), absent statuses omitted.
- report::to_line: "id,customer,total,status". report::from_line: trims the whole line only; splits on ','; field count error "expected 4 fields, got N"; validates id, then total, then status; errors are `bad id "x": invalid digit found in string`, `bad total ...`, `unknown status "lost"`; status is case-sensitive and untrimmed.

Refactor guidance (the refactorer must preserve these):
1. status_counts must stay alphabetical by name. A derived Ord on the enum sorts by declaration order and would break the pinned test; sort by as_str or the name instead.
2. from_line's unknown-status error must stay `unknown status {:?}` of the raw field. Any ParseStatusError Display must produce exactly that. Keep validation order id, total, status, and keep the whole-line trim only.
3. FromStr must accept exactly the four lowercase names, with no trim and no case folding.

Allowed or open exceptions (not pinned, decisions for the operator or verifier):
- Order's derived Debug output changes from `status: "paid"` to `status: Paid`. The brief forces this; it is not pinned.
- A public `Order.status` could previously be set to any string; the brief removes that.
- Status literals remain in tests/orders.rs and tests/characterization.rs as expected values. The brief's "only in src/status.rs" is read here as covering crate code; the parent should confirm.

Feedback: none (attempt 1).

Known gaps: no pinning of the Debug format (above). Nothing is running; no services were started.

stages.summary:
Refactored the orders crate so Order.status is an OrderStatus enum. Two local commits on archon/xnbzmv1m-refactor-orders-status-string-into-order, on top of the characterization commits 0177dea and 64a3af7: 8b78161 adds src/status.rs (OrderStatus with as_str, Display, can_transition_to, FromStr; public ParseStatusError whose Display is exactly `unknown status {:?}`), wired into lib.rs with re-exports. 5f7ee80 switches order, billing, shipping and report to it. HEAD is 5f7ee80f73c8c1e7ea571df185c8e1358588eff9, tree 42943e03c950cf2b967b34f2060086c3a3cc396c, and the worktree is clean.

Structure: pay, ship and cancel use can_transition_to, which encodes pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped and paid->cancelled. status_counts sorts by as_str so the output stays alphabetical. from_line keeps the trim, field-count, id, total, then status validation order, and FromStr does no trim and no case folding. Status literals in crate code exist only in src/status.rs.

Checks run at the final tree: cargo test passes (5 new unit tests in status.rs, 15 characterization, 3 existing). cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0. cargo fmt --check exits 1 on the same pre-existing drift as baseline; my edits add no new unformatted lines. Commit 8b78161 was also built standalone and passes. Logs are published as refactor-evidence/ on item qi_01M8GKTGCB1VJ0TS5FXNBZMV1M.

Pre-existing tests are unmodified: tests/orders.rs and the characterization commits are untouched by this work. Brief-authorised exception: Order.status is now OrderStatus, and Order's derived Debug prints `status: Paid` instead of `status: "paid"`. Literals remain in test files as expected values.

Risk is high because Order.status is a breaking public API change for callers. Nothing is running and no services were started.

pr.body: Approach: src/status.rs defines OrderStatus (as_str, Display via f.pad, can_transition_to, FromStr) and ParseStatusError. Its Display is exactly `unknown status {:?}`, the text from_line produced before. status is a private module re-exported from the crate root. Commit 8b78161 adds the module and its unit tests; commit 5f7ee80 switches Order, billing, shipping and report to it. pay, ship and cancel check can_transition_to: pending->paid, paid->shipped, and cancel allowed from pending or paid, which matches the old string checks exactly. status_counts keeps Vec<(String,usize)> and sorts by as_str, so output stays alphabetical. from_line keeps trim-the-whole-line, field count, id, total, then status validation order. FromStr does no trim and no case folding. Checks: cargo test passes (5 unit, 15 characterization, 3 existing). cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes. cargo fmt --check fails only on pre-existing drift in the same files as baseline; no new unformatted lines were introduced. Tests: no pre-existing test was modified; tests/characterization.rs and tests/orders.rs are unchanged since baseline. Assumptions and limits: Order.status is a public field whose type changes, as the brief requires, and Order's derived Debug now prints `status: Paid` instead of `status: "paid"`. Status literals remain in tests as expected values. Nothing is running, and no services were started.
pr.summary: Made order status a typed OrderStatus enum. Now: lifecycle rules live in can_transition_to, parsing is FromStr with ParseStatusError, literals only in src/status.rs. Before: Order.status was a String compared against literals in order, billing, shipping and report. Error text, report output and ordering are unchanged.
pr.title: refactor: store order status as OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Breaking public API change: Order.status changes from String to OrderStatus, so external callers that read or assign strings break. The change also touches the status model across four modules. Behaviour is pinned by 18 characterization and existing tests, which all pass, and error/report output is unchanged.
